en.headline: Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival returns to Central Harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board features more than 340 booths, new country pavilions and a Maxim’s food street marking the group’s 70th anniversary.
body: The Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival will return to the Central Harbourfront Event Space and Tamar Park from 29 October to 1 November, organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board under the theme “Taste the World’s Best”.

The Tourism Board said the festival will have more than 340 booths from about 31 countries and regions, an increase of over 10 per cent from last year, with the footprint extended to Tamar Park. New pavilions from Australia, Canada and South Korea will appear for the first time. Opening hours will run until 1am on the Friday and Saturday for the first time.

Maxim’s Group will mark its 70th anniversary with a food street called Maxim’s Boulevard inside the festival. The group’s Hong Kong and Macau chief operating officer Emmy Kan said the street would let visitors wander and sample flavours from 10 of its brands, including festival-only pineapple bun burgers.
Admission tickets are available in advance. The Tourism Board said the festival would be followed by Hong Kong Gourmet Month throughout November.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳養巡禮10月29日起中環海濱舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日活動設逾340攤位，首設澳洲、加拿大及韓國展館，並有美心集團70周年美食街。
body: 香港旅遊發展局主辦的「香港美酒佳養巡禮」將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行，主題為「品味世界之最」。
旅發局表示，今年巡禮設有超過340個攤位，較去年增加逾一成，場地擴展至添馬公園。澳洲、加拿大及韓國展館將首次登場。周五及周六開放時間首次延至凌晨1時。
美心集團為慶祝成立70周年，在巡禮內設「美心大道」美食街。集團港澳營運總裁簡慧明表示，訪客可沿街品嘗集團10個品牌的美食，包括僅於巡禮供應的菠蘿包漢堡。
入場門票可預先購買。旅發局指，巡禮後11月全月將推出「香港美食月」。
